project.name: Customer Portal Modernisation
project.summary: Fabrikam wants to replace its legacy customer portal with a cloud-native application on Azure.
objectives: Migrate the customer portal to Azure Container Apps
Introduce single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID

in_scope: Implementation of the portal front end and API
Data migration of active customer accounts

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: Workshops to confirm requirements, architecture and the migration approach.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Iterative delivery in two-week sprints with a demo at the end of each sprint.

phases.name: Transition
phases.description: Data migration, cut-over and hypercare for four weeks.

deliverables.name: Solution architecture
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Approved by the Customer architecture board

deliverables.name: Portal release 1.0
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: All acceptance tests pass; no open severity 1 defects

customer_dependencies: Access to the test environment (SAP_QA) by 2026-11-16
Named product owner available two days per week
assumptions: The Customer provides test data that contains no personal data
Work is performed remotely unless agreed otherwise
